scope: Only the 24 Western/Northern European map identities. No Batch 02 research.
policy: Every fact is independently sourced and dated. Review intervals accept specified periods only; missing fields and temporal gaps are deliberate. Names alone are not core completion.
architectureDecision: Retain the two static schema-1 JSON files and cached temporal index. No backend, runtime data split, geometry change or UI redesign is required for this batch.

limitations: Acceptance is by reviewed interval, not global 1800–1960 coverage. Many core-accepted raw identities also have earlier partial periods.
Austrian Netherlands in 1800 is a proven source-label problem; Luxembourg in 1800 remains outside the grand-ducal mapping.
Finland 1917, Iceland 1918 and Switzerland 1848 deliberately produce whole-calendar identity ambiguity. UK 1801 begins on 1 January and is not ambiguous.
The exact/nearest map snapshot remains independent of requested-year facts; source-layer absence does not imply dissolution.
No new population, flag, area or GDP data. All original sources, flags and observations remain.
No new simplified predecessor/successor chains. Union and constitutional developments are recorded as dated events and explicit relationships.
